name_zh: 斯里兰卡·杜特加穆努：统一与佛教水利文明
name_en: Sri Lanka Dutugemunu: Unification & Buddhist Water Civilization
description_zh: 杜特加穆努 (公元前161-前137) 阿努拉德普拉国王，统一斯里兰卡建立僧伽罗佛教王朝，建造鲁瓦纳威利大塔与灌溉水库网络，奠定斯里兰卡水利文明与佛教国家认同基础。
description_en: Dutugemunu (161-137 BC) Anuradhapura King, unified Sri Lanka established Sinhalese Buddhist dynasty, built Ruwanwelisaya stupa and irrigation reservoir network, founded Sri Lankan hydraulic civilization and Buddhist national identity basis.
reason_zh: 杜特加穆努代表南亚佛教王国通过水利基建与宗教合法性双轮驱动实现统一的典范，展示了古代水文工程如何支撑人口密集型文明，其大塔至今是斯里兰卡佛教朝圣中心。
reason_en: Dutugemunu represents South Asian Buddhist kingdom unification paradigm driven by hydraulic infrastructure and religious legitimacy dual wheels, demonstrating how ancient hydraulic engineering supported population-dense civilization, his great stupa remains Sri Lankan Buddhist pilgrimage center today.
steps_zh: 研究杜特加穆努早年南方王子与厄拉拉泰米尔国王对抗
分析统一战争与阿努拉德普拉佛教王朝建立
探讨鲁瓦纳威利大塔建造与佛教圣地化
评估灌溉水库网络支撑稻作文明与人口繁荣
总结统一佛教水利石碑对斯里兰卡文明的两千年奠基
steps_en: Study Dutugemunu early southern prince vs Elara Tamil king confrontation
Analyze unification war and Anuradhapura Buddhist dynasty establishment
Explore Ruwanwelisaya stupa construction and Buddhist sanctification
Evaluate irrigation reservoir network supporting rice civilization and population prosperity
Summarize unification Buddhism water stupa two-millennium foundation for Sri Lankan civilization
expected_zh: 掌握水利文明与佛教王权双重合法性构建逻辑，理解古代水文工程如何成为国家建构核心基础设施，评估杜特加穆努对斯里兰卡僧伽罗佛教认同的决定性奠基。
expected_en: Master hydraulic civilization and Buddhist kingship dual legitimacy construction logic, understand how ancient hydraulic engineering becomes nation-building core infrastructure, evaluate Dutugemunu decisive foundation for Sri Lankan Sinhalese Buddhist identity.
case_zh: 前161 出生；前161 即位；前137 逝世。统一佛教水利文明范式永存。
case_en: 161 BC birth; 161 BC accession; 137 BC death. Unification Buddhist water civilization paradigm endures.
cross_cultural_impact: Sri Lanka unification; hydraulic civilization; Buddhist stupa; Sinhalese identity
